content_sections.heading: Power Foundation of India Recruitment 2026 - Quick Overview
Power Foundation of India Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Asst. Manager (Hydro) and 1 for Asst. Manager (Transmission).

content_sections.heading: Power Foundation of India Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
content_sections.text: Asst. Manager (Hydro) Support studies and policy initiatives on hydro and pumped storage development Review DPRs, feasibility studies, and hydrological assessments Evaluate hydroelectric projects and emerging technologies Coordinate with CPSUs, State Utilities, CEA, and Ministry of Power Monitor hydro regulations, environmental clearances, and rehabilitation frameworks Asst. Manager (Transmission) Analyze power transmission sector developments and emerging technologies Review transmission project proposals, DPRs, and feasibility reports Undertake studies on grid expansion, renewable energy evacuation, and Green Energy Corridors Coordinate with Central/State utilities, CPSUs, Regulatory Commissions, CEA, and CTU Monitor transmission regulations, standards, and best practices

rows.essential: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (min. 60%)
rows.desirable: M.Tech/ME in Hydropower, Power Systems, or Water Resources; MBA/PGDM in Power Management
M.Tech/ME in Power Systems; MBA/PGDM in Power/Infrastructure Management; certification in Transmission Systems or Grid Operations

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum 35 years as on the closing date of application, for both posts.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Pay Scale
content_sections.text: Both posts carry a compensation of INR 15–20 Lakh per annum , on a regular basis.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online from 09 July 2026 to 06 August 2026 (up to 6 PM) . The application window closes strictly at 6 PM on the last date, so candidates are advised to complete the process well in advance. The application link and detailed submission steps are available on the official Power Foundation of India website; candidates should keep scanned copies of certificates and documents ready before starting the online form.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready: Updated resume/CV Educational certificates and mark sheets (Bachelor's degree, and M.Tech/MBA if applicable) Experience certificates from previous employers Age proof Self-declaration certifying no pending criminal case, disciplinary action, or appellate proceedings

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The selected candidate must submit a self-declaration certifying no pending criminal case or disciplinary/appellate proceedings. The Competent Authority may verify antecedents within six months of engagement; confirmation of the provisional engagement depends on a satisfactory verification report. If any information furnished is found false, incorrect, or misleading, the engagement may be cancelled and civil/criminal proceedings may follow. Any matter not specifically covered under the notification will be decided by the Director General, PFI, and such decisions shall be final.

faq.question: Q1. Which organisation is recruiting for Asst. Manager posts in 2026?
faq.answer: Power Foundation of India (PFI), a not-for-profit organisation promoted by leading power sector CPSUs, is recruiting.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under PFI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Asst. Manager (Hydro) and 1 for Asst. Manager (Transmission).

faq.question: Q3. What is the compensation for PFI Asst. Manager posts?
faq.answer: The compensation ranges from INR 15 to 20 lakh per annum for both posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification for the Asst. Manager (Hydro) post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential qualification for the Asst. Manager (Transmission) post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q6. How much experience is required for these posts?
faq.answer: A minimum of 8 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant power sector domain is required for both posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for PFI Asst. Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: Both posts are based in New Delhi.
